Bottom-right: two small parchment scrolls, a quill in brass inkpot, and seal stamp on two closed books (reference 4). Each vignette centered in its own quadrant with at least 8% clear padding, do not cross cell boundaries. Match their relative scale and optical weight. No plants or extra background that would collide with a plot. Transparent empty canvas around every object.
